title: Check revision and authoritative phase deadlines inside transactions
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md, docs/design/SWARM-BRIEF-v0.md, docs/design/RULES-SPEC-v1.md and the listed sourceRefs before editing. The imported Rules Spec v1 is the canonical engine contract; the earlier prototype/T01-T10 interfaces are baseline compatibility, not current gameplay rules. Do not restore approval votes, Repair/Sabotage buttons, Witness or five-node tracks. Preserve original IP and engine independence from Firebase/UI/Node. Edit only ownership; publish APIs only through explicitly owned package entrypoints, preserving baseline exports. Use original synthetic fixtures, scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check. Do not commit, push, open PRs, spawn agents, provision/deploy services, access credentials or alter swarm budget. Implement the service transaction guard around canonical safe revisions,phase generation and server-injected trustedNow/roundDeadline. Clients cannot set/pause/extend the clock or active-match timer; reject stale/future revisions and overflow without state changes. Delegate phase/deadline policy and timer adjustments to the engine A014 contract,including30/60/90/120 base settings and specified anomaly/Blackout adjustments. A local menu,animation completion or client timestamp never authorizes advance. Expose only the fixed safe refresh/status metadata approved by A051; do not return authoritative private state on conflict.
acceptance: Two actions with the same expected revision cannot both overwrite authority as if each were current.
Early advance,late intent,wrong phase generation,unsafe revision and stale deadline callbacks are rejected or reconciled as defined by the engine contract.
Client time/pause/timer overrides cannot alter an active multiplayer deadline or its canonical reductions.
Tests use injected time around exact boundaries and verify no private fields leak on revision/phase/deadline failures.
